correct_completion: I handed it to my manager.
full_sentence: Having finished the report, I handed it to my manager.
acceptable_variants: I sent it to my manager by email.
I gave it to my manager the same afternoon.

options.why_wrong: The participle clause 'Having finished' needs a main clause whose subject is the person who finished the report. A printer cannot be the one who finished it.
This describes the setting but does not give the action that should follow the participle clause.

options.text: I handed it to my manager.
my manager was sleeping in the office.
options.why_wrong: This gives a new state of the manager, but the subject of the main clause must be the person who finished the report.

grammar_focus: Participle clauses whose implied subject matches the subject of the main clause
explanation: A participle clause at the start of a sentence needs the same subject as the main clause. The main clause must therefore describe what the person who finished the report did next.
translation: Depois de terminar o relatório, entreguei-o ao meu gerente.
